stem: Which one of the following can provide both power and manure?
expl: Biogas refers to a mixture of different gases produced by the breakdown of organic matter in the absence of oxygen. Biogas can be produced from raw materials such as agricultural waste, manure, sewage, green waste, etc. It provides both power and manure.

stem: When was 'Speed Post Service' launched by the Indian Postal Department in competition to the 'Courier service'?
expl: The Department of India Post started the Speed Post Service in August 1986. This service provides time-bound and express delivery of letters and parcels between specified stations in India. If the Speed Post is not delivered within the time then the postal department refunds postal charges to the customers.

stem: At one of the places in India, if you stand on the seashore and watch the sea, you will find that the seawater recedes from the shoreline a few kilometers and comes back to the shore, twice a day, and you can actually walk on the sea floor when the water recedes. This unique phenomenon is seen at
expl: The above-mentioned phenomenon is seen at the seashore of Chandipur in the state of Odisha. One can walk into the sea floor as the seawater recedes away from the shoreline during the ebb tide (the time period between the high tide and low tide).

stem: Which one of the following is the most important reason for the establishment of the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre at Thumba?

options.label: c

options.label: d

expl: Thumba is a suburb of Thiruvananthapuram city, the capital of Kerala. stem: Which of the following is not used in connection with sarees?
expl: Moradabad is famous worldwide for brassworks and glassware. Moradabad is also known by the name of Peetal Nagri. Thus Moradabad is not related to sarees. expl: Among the popular festivals of Mizoram, Mim Kut, Pawl Kut and Chapchar Kut, the 'Chapchar Kut festival' is celebrated in the month of March. stem: Recently, there was a growing awareness in our country about the importance of Himalayan nettle (Girardinia diversifolia) because it is found to be a sustainable source of-
expl: Himalayan nettle (Girardinia diversifolia) is a plant found in the Himalayas and the Hindukush region, whose fiber is becoming increasingly popular for use in the textile industry. This plant is found in Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Jammu and Kashmir and several northeastern states of India, where efforts are being made by local weavers to increase its use in textile manufacturing.
